objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: nasal congestion

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I have nasal congestion with a clear runny nose, along with a cough that produces colored or more abundant sputum than usual, and I also notice wheezing when I exhale.
[ASK] Do you have wheezing or shortness of breath that is worse with breathing (suggesting lower-airway bronchospasm)?
Yes—I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale.
[ASK] Do you have wheezing or a history of asthma/COPD with symptoms that improve after bronchodilator use?
Yes—I have COPD. I also notice wheezing when I exhale.
[DDX] Acute COPD exacerbation / infection  , Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation
